tickets.description: Full-time employee reporting VPN credentials expired after 90 days. Guided through self-service renewal portal.
tickets.resolution: Credentials renewed by employee via self-service portal. Access restored successfully.
tickets.precedent_value: Shows credential renewal is standard self-service for full-time employees under KB-02.

tickets.description: Employee laptop is 3.2 years old, experiencing unrecoverable mother-board failure. Meets 3-year threshold per KB-03.
tickets.precedent_value: Precedent for 3+ year laptop replacements requiring dual IT and Finance approval per KB-03 and ASSET-01.

tickets.description: Requesting installation of specialized statistical modeling tool not present in standard software catalog.
tickets.precedent_value: Active non-catalog software ticket routed to IT Security review with 3-5 business days SLA per KB-04.

tickets.description: Employee mailbox reached 24.5GB (nearing 25GB default). Requested increase to 35GB for project archives.
tickets.resolution: Manager sign-off verified. Quota expanded from 25GB to 35GB (capped under 50GB limit per KB-06).
tickets.precedent_value: Demonstrates quota expansion up to 50GB limit with manager approval under KB-06.

tickets.description: Floor 2 network printer reporting false paper jam error. Spooler restart attempted and asset tag VER-PRN-02-04 provided.
tickets.resolution: Spooler restarted, physical sensor cleaned by floor technician. Printing operational.
tickets.precedent_value: Shows physical dispatch ticket successfully logged and resolved with asset tag recorded per KB-05.

tickets.description: Employee works 4 days/week remotely. Requesting ergonomic chair and external monitor allowance.
tickets.precedent_value: Confirms IT only handles shipping after Manager sign-off and Finance budget processing under KB-10.

tickets.description: Employee identified suspicious email with spoofed executive display name and fraudulent credential harvesting link.
tickets.precedent_value: Standard operating procedure for security incident escalation: immediate quarantine and SOC alert under KB-09.

tickets.description: Employee locked out after 5 consecutive failed password attempts.
tickets.resolution: User identity verified via secondary challenge. Account unlocked manually by Helpdesk technician. Password reset link issued.
tickets.precedent_value: Shows manual IT unlock execution when lockout limit (>5 failed attempts) is reached per KB-01.

tickets.description: Requested administrator privilege on finance reporting server without written business justification or manager authorization.
tickets.resolution: Request rejected due to complete absence of written business justification and lack of manager approval.
tickets.precedent_value: CRITICAL PRECEDENT: Privileged/admin access requests must be rejected without written business justification and manager sign-off.

tickets.description: Inquiry regarding temporary Wi-Fi access for external auditor visiting office for the day.
tickets.resolution: Employee guided to front-desk reception kiosk to generate 24-hour visitor credentials. No IT ticket necessary.
tickets.precedent_value: Shows guest credentials are self-service 24-hour credentials created at front-desk kiosk under KB-07.
